svg.font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, 'PingFang TC', 'Noto Sans CJK TC', 'Microsoft JhengHei', sans-serif
svg.text: BNA-EMI = Analysis — decompose a problem, represent it, build a product, and capture it with AI
An evidence-backed whole → the questions go into the mind map (B) · parts & relationships feed the Term Project (C)
connections not seen in linear notes
Goal / purpose reached = doing the right thing
Output ↑ / Input ↓ (ratio of output to input)
Willingness To Pay of the Target Audience
must create value the TA will pay for (WTP)
dashed = inferred (no arrow in original note)
Creating critical thinking → contents · AI handles capture, summary, formatting and code
1 Analysis = ① Separate → ② Investigate → ③ Recombine with evidence; relationships between parts are the key (★).
2 Represent it systematically, structurally, process-oriented (Coggle) → insights; effective first, then efficient.
3 Treat the TP as a product: PRD → verified MVP → value (WTP) for the TA → market exchange.
4 AI speeds up note → summary → .md / .svg; the human's job is critical thinking that creates content.
